source: python -m baseball.edge.stuffplus_benchmark 2026, on the bb edge 2026 pitch tables, the regular-season pitch files, the Savant leaderboard files of the Savant benchmark, and the FanGraphs Stuff+ table described below.
what_this_is: Expected whiff against FanGraphs Stuff+ by pitch type, 2025 and 2026. Stuff+ is built to predict run value; expected whiff is built to predict swings and misses.

description: FanGraphs Major League Leaderboards, Pitching, "Stuff+" tab (type=36), single seasons 2025 and 2026, no innings minimum.
Pages read 2026-11-15 as displayed to any visitor (no sign-in, no export):

Kept in this file: 2025: the first 708 rows as sorted by Pitching+ (all innings), plus every later row with 15+ IP (26 rows; the other 139 later rows had under 15 IP and were not kept). 2026: every row with 15+ IP (597 rows).

Columns: fgid is the FanGraphs player id from the player link. FA SI FC FS SL CU CH KC FO are Stuff+ by pitch type; stuff, loc, pitching are Stuff+, Location+, Pitching+. NA = blank on the page. Names and teams are present for the first 708 rows of 2025 only.
2024 table (file stuff_plus_by_pitch_2024.csv), read 2026-11-15 the same way:
Page total: 855 pitchers. Kept: every row with 15+ IP (588 rows). Names and teams not kept.

limits: One held-out test: weights fit on 2024 into 2025, scored on 2025 into 2026. There is no second scoring year.
Stuff+ by pitch type exists only for the columns FanGraphs lists: FA SI FC FS SL CU CH KC FO.
The 2024 and 2026 tables are pitchers with 15+ innings. The 2025 table leaves out 139 pitchers who threw under 15 innings and keeps the under-15 pitchers only from its first 708 rows by Pitching+.
FanGraphs ids with no link in the Chadwick register are left out; no names are matched.

id_mapping.how: FanGraphs player id to MLBAM id through the Chadwick register (key_fangraphs to key_mlbam)

pitch_type_rule.in_words: FF to FA; SI, FC, FS, FO, CH, KC to the same name; sweepers (ST) to SL and slurves (SV) to CU. Where a pitcher throws both pitches of a shared column, my pitch is matched only if it is at least 90% of his pitches in that column; otherwise it is dropped.

floors.mine: 60 swings with complete tracking in each season used

weighting: RMSE and fits weighted by sqrt(min swings in the two seasons), as in stuff.validate_holdout()
